characters.white: Approved set-01 neutral adult with black hair, white gi, brown belt
characters.blue: Approved set-01 neutral adult with white hair, blue gi, brown belt

style.layout: Two anatomically separate partners, readable decisive contacts, no text or logos

scope_note: Pose drafting only. This file does not record image generation, final image review, DB changes, or deployment.

items.name: 스탠딩
items.poseBrief: Show both adults standing face to face in a balanced grappling stance, knees softly bent and feet staggered. White establishes a light collar and sleeve contact while blue maintains posture and realistic distance. Show an ordinary starting position before any takedown is committed.
keyChecks: Both athletes remain standing with grounded feet
Collar and sleeve contacts connect to the correct hands
No completed throw or fixed takedown is implied

items.name: 싱글 레그 테이크다운
items.poseBrief: Show white lowering level beside blue and collecting one of blue's legs with both arms. White stays connected at the hip while blue balances on the other foot. Freeze the controlled entry before the finish, making the captured leg and supporting leg unmistakably separate.
keyChecks: Exactly one blue leg is collected
White's torso remains beside the captured hip
Blue's free foot provides the remaining base

items.name: 칼라 드래그
items.poseBrief: Show a standing collar drag with white stepping off the centerline while drawing blue forward through a genuine lapel grip. Blue's shoulders turn and balance shifts toward the planted hands or forward foot. Preserve the opening toward blue's flank rather than depicting a straight backward shove.
keyChecks: A visible white hand actually holds blue's collar
Pull and lateral step open an angle
Blue's forward imbalance follows the collar connection

items.name: 앵클 픽
items.poseBrief: Show white maintaining an upper body connection while lowering to collect blue's near ankle. Blue is beginning to lose balance over the opposite supporting leg. Keep white's reaching hand at the ankle, not the knee, and show a controlled setup rather than a violent airborne fall.
keyChecks: One hand connects to the selected ankle
Upper body control and ankle collection act together
Blue retains one recognizable supporting leg

items.name: 더블 레그 테이크다운
items.poseBrief: Show white entering at a lowered level with both arms collecting blue's thighs near the knees. White's chest connects to the hips and the spine stays naturally aligned. Blue's legs remain distinct as the drive begins; neither athlete floats above the floor without support.
keyChecks: Both blue legs are captured rather than one
White's head and torso stay beside the hips
The drive has a visible grounded base

items.name: 인사이드 트립
items.poseBrief: Show white and blue connected in a standing clinch. White controls blue's upper body while an attacking leg enters between blue's legs to obstruct the inside of one leg. Freeze the off balancing moment, with the support foot visibly grounded and the hooking leg anatomically continuous.
keyChecks: The attacking leg approaches the inside of blue's leg
Upper body clinch remains connected
White has a separate grounded support leg

items.name: 아웃사이드 트립
items.poseBrief: Show white controlling blue in a standing clinch and placing an attacking leg outside blue's supporting leg. The upper body pull and outside obstruction guide blue off balance together. Keep the two hips and all four legs readable so this cannot be mistaken for an inside trip.
keyChecks: The obstruction is outside the chosen blue leg
Clinch pressure and leg action share one direction
Four legs remain visibly separate

items.name: 낙법
items.poseBrief: Show white demonstrating a controlled backward breakfall on the floor with a rounded back, chin gently tucked, and arms spreading to contact the mat. Blue kneels nearby as an observing partner, not an attacker. Emphasize the falling posture rather than a submission or a completed throw.
keyChecks: White's head does not strike the floor
Arms belong naturally to the falling torso
Blue is a separate observing partner

items.name: 테이크다운
items.poseBrief: Illustrate the broad takedown concept using a representative standing clinch where white has broken blue's balance and is beginning to guide blue toward the floor. Keep the scene generic and connected, without locking the composition to a named wrestling shot or a particular judo throw.
keyChecks: The action begins with both athletes standing
Blue's balance is visibly disrupted through contact
This is one representative example, not the entire definition

items.name: 오픈 가드
items.poseBrief: Show blue on the back facing a standing or kneeling white partner, with knees between the torsos and uncrossed feet controlling distance. Use a simple open leg barrier without a distinctive lasso, spider, or leg entanglement. White stays outside the hips, making the open structure clear.
keyChecks: Blue's ankles are not locked behind white
Both knees remain useful distance barriers
No specialized guard is presented as the only open guard

items.name: 클로즈 가드
items.poseBrief: Show blue lying comfortably beneath a kneeling white partner, with both legs wrapping white's waist and ankles visibly crossed behind the back. keyChecks: Blue's legs surround white's waist
The crossed ankles belong to blue
White remains between the closed legs

items.name: 하프 가드
items.poseBrief: Show blue on one side beneath white, trapping exactly one of white's legs between blue's two legs. White's other leg remains outside and free for balance. Keep the upper bodies connected without converting the position into closed guard or a completed side control pin.

White's other leg is visibly free

items.name: 델라히바 가드

items.name: 딥 하프 가드

items.name: 스파이더 가드

items.name: 웜 가드
